text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority. The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews at its July 3, 2019 meeting and recommend seven candidates to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates to be interviewed at the July 3, 2019 meeting of the Committee for appointment to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority: TRC1-9 TRC1-43 TRC2-3 TRC2-6 TRC2-8 TRC2-9 TRC2-11 TRC2-17 TRC2-22 TRC2-23 TRC2-25 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 23, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority.
